site.name: Make Bold Spark
site.tagline: Spec-Driven Systems. Real Applications. Practical AI.
site.description: Make Bold Spark is an ecosystem of open-source tools, reference implementations, and practical development patterns for building better software with AI-assisted workflows.

systems.name: DevSpark
systems.purpose: Turn ideas into structured implementation workflows.
systems.summary: A spec-driven, agent-agnostic development harness for moving from intent to implementation-ready plans, tasks, and reviewable context.
systems.valueProposition: DevSpark helps teams turn fuzzy ideas into precise, agent-ready implementation workflows.
capabilities: Reviewable handoffs from idea to code
systems.philosophy: DevSpark treats AI-assisted development as a systems problem. Better outputs come from clearer specifications, explicit constraints, and workflow context that can be reviewed before code is produced.
systems.whatItIs: DevSpark is the flagship Make Bold Spark system for spec-driven development workflows.
systems.whyItExists: It exists to make AI-assisted software delivery more deliberate, inspectable, and repeatable.

systems.name: ApiTestSpark
systems.purpose: Explore APIs and validate repeatable request workflows.
systems.summary: A system for OpenAPI-driven exploration, API testing, and repeatable workflow validation.
systems.valueProposition: ApiTestSpark turns API contracts and live behavior into practical testing and implementation context.
systems.philosophy: ApiTestSpark starts from the contract, then grounds the work in concrete request behavior so documentation, tests, and clients stay close to reality.
systems.whatItIs: ApiTestSpark is the Make Bold Spark system for API exploration and workflow testing.
systems.whyItExists: It exists because reliable API work needs more than static documentation; it needs repeatable examples and observable behavior.

systems.name: WebSpark
systems.purpose: Capture the long-running web platform lineage behind Make Bold Spark.
systems.summary: A web platform and reference implementation lineage for content, publishing, recipes, and reusable application patterns.
systems.valueProposition: WebSpark provides the practical web application foundation that informs the Make Bold Spark ecosystem.
systems.philosophy: WebSpark favors real application patterns over abstract demos, preserving the lessons that come from maintaining web systems over time.
systems.whatItIs: WebSpark is the web platform and application lineage behind many Make Bold Spark reference systems.
systems.whyItExists: It exists to keep reusable web patterns grounded in working software.

systems.name: ApiSpark
systems.purpose: Provide focused API examples, integration patterns, and reusable service implementations.
systems.summary: An API-focused reference system for small focused APIs, integration patterns, public content endpoints, and service examples.
systems.valueProposition: ApiSpark demonstrates focused API design patterns that can be inspected, tested, and reused.
capabilities: Health, auth, and async workflow examples
systems.philosophy: ApiSpark keeps API examples small enough to understand while still being real enough to validate architecture, testing, and integration choices.
systems.whatItIs: ApiSpark is the API-focused reference implementation for the Make Bold Spark ecosystem.
systems.whyItExists: It exists to make API architecture and integration patterns concrete.

articles.title: DevSpark as a Spec-Driven Development Harness
articles.summary: A practical introduction to positioning DevSpark as an agent-agnostic harness for turning intent into implementation-ready workflows.
